reason: Machine lens: all opcodes real on the 65SC12 (LDA abs,X BD, STA abs 8D, LDY abs,X BC, LDA abs,Y B9, BEQ); Baron syntax fine in the cmos section. Recount: old LDA abs,X 4 + STA 4 + LDA abs,X 4 + STA 4 + LDY #0 2 + JSR 6 + LDA abs,Y 4 + RTS 6 = 34; new LDA abs,X 4 + STA 4 + LDY abs,X 4 + LDA abs,Y 4 = 16. Neither first-byte read ever crosses a page (old: base = ptr, Y = 0; new: base hi:00, Y = lo). Saving is 18 cycles a call, not the claimed 20 (overstated by 2). Bytes: old 3+3+3+3+2+3 = 17, new 12: 5 smaller (ramp's 4 bytes left dead). BEQ ended and ended's BRA sfx_write both move with their targets (-5 each), offsets unchanged and in range; JSR sfx_next_ramp.ended from sfx_silence reassembles. Self-modified operand nr_c1_b0+2 is written only by its own STA just before, under the interrupt / SEI; no other writer of ramp+1/+2 in src/. Shift of -5 after A4F5: sfx tables A5C7-A5EF -> A5C2-A5EA, X <= 3, no crossing; sfx_effect_lo/hi-1,Y (A67E/A686 -> A679/A681, Y <= 8) no crossing; the compiled_bank5 code after it: no taken branch starts or stops crossing a page (scanned the listing). One side effect the relies_on misses: the sfx_data ramps move 5 bytes against &A600, so which ramp straddles that page changes for nr_c1_b1..5 (+1 per crossing load): effect_08's ramp at A5FD (3 crossings) becomes A5F8 (none) and its ramp at A603 becomes A5FE (4 crossings): +1 cycle once per effect_08 played; negligible against 18 saved per call. Correct and faster; claim's 20 should be recorded as 18.
